eas_text: A civil authority has issued A SHELTER IN PLACE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Coconino, AZ; at 5:47 PM on AUG 22, 2023 Effective until 9:47 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text:
Urgent notice to Tusayan and Grand Canyon Village: ALL SCHOOL CHILDREN ARE SAFE. Remaining children will be sheltered at school until they can be safely evacuated. 

PLEASE DO NOT ATTEMPT TO DRIVE TO THE SCHOOL, ROADS ARE CLOSED.
